scientific_integrity: The exact analytic derivation and reproducible independent numerical diagnostics are included; numerical diagnostics are corroborative, not a proof. Historical priority and independent mathematical review remain unresolved.
scientific_limitations: Requires a filled planar disk and one fixed-length nonhorizontal generator with positive normal component, normalized isotropic line orientations, positive radius and generator length. Inverse tilt recovery requires both lengths known. The planar stadium is limiting only. Does not supply the full oblique-width distribution, nor fixed-volume optimization.
title: Sharp obliquity law for isotropic width variance of circular cylinders
